headlines.summary: This week's celebration of Macy's 100th Thanksgiving parade finds the department store at a turning point. After years of losing sales, the retailer is reimagining itself — as a higher-end destination.

headlines.title: Russia, Ukraine exchange bodies of fallen soldiers in Belarus

headlines.title: Africa urged to accelerate health sector's self-reliance
headlines.summary: African leaders have called for a decisive shift toward greater health self-reliance, warning that the continent's dependence on external financing and imported medical supplies leaves its health systems vulnerable to changing global funding priorities and public health emergencies.

headlines.title: Experts call for AI safety cooperation
